entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. My VeloBand is a piece of junk. It's completely broken and I want my money back, now!

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your device. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
Are you kidding me? A preference? It's not working! It's defective! The pulse reading is all over the place and it won't sync with the app anymore. I've tried everything. I want a refund.
Okay, thank you for clarifying that it's a technical issue. I understand your frustration. Let me just pull up your order information to check the return eligibility.

There's nothing to check! This is ridiculous customer service. Just process the return! If you don't, I swear I'm going to leave a one-star review on every website I can find. Get me your manager right now!

Sir, I understand you're upset, and I do apologize for the inconvenience. I'm just checking our policy now... Okay, I see you received the item 21 days ago. According to our knowledge base, we have a 90-day return window. So yes, you are well within the timeframe. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh. Well... okay then. Good. That's all I wanted. So you're sending me a shipping label?

Yes, absolutely. I'm generating a pre-paid return label and I've just sent it to the email address on your account. As soon as we receive the defective band back at our warehouse, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. You should see that within 3-5 business days after we receive it.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
